assistantAcceptance: This is a targeted release. The complete paid generation matrix and the complete assistant suite are not rerun or represented as passed. Historical media/assistant failures and financial uncertainty remain recorded from the v2.0.3 receipt.
communicationInstruction: 正式发版成功后在飞书 Beefteam 沟通群通知 Lucas，总结本版真实改动、版本链接、验收结果与遗留限制。
